ZUZANA GOLDSTEIN FOR THE PLTF. NORMAN WILBER FOR THE DEFT. 2:20PM C/C FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE. ALL PARTIES PRESENT TERMS AND CONDITIONS STATED ON RECORD. PLAINTIFF IS AWARDED JUDGMENT FOR RESTITUTION OF PREMISES OF THE GARAGE LOCATED AT 3660 20TH STREET AGAINST THE DEFT NORMAN WILBER. EXECUTION OF JUDGMENT SHALL BE STAYED THROUGH 30-NOV-93. IF DEFT FAIL TO SURRENDER POSSE- SSION OF PREMISES PLAINTIFF SHALL BE ENTITLED TO IMMEDIATE ENTRY OF JUDGMENT FOR POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES, RENTS, DAMAGES AND COSTS INCLUDING REASON- ABLE ATTORNEY'S FEES. IF DEFT VOLUNTARY SURRENDER POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES PLAINTIFF WILL DISMISS THE COMPLAINT WITH PREJUDICE. IF JUDGMENT IS ENTERED THERE ARE NO STAYS OF EXECUTION. DEFT STIPULATES THERE ARE NO OTHER ADULTS IN POSSESSION OF PREMISES. DEFT HAVE HAD THE OPPORTUNITY TO OBTAIN AND BE REP- RESENTED BY COUNSEL IN THIS ACTION. THE PARTIES FURTHER STIPULATE THAT NO REPRESENTATION OTHER THAN AS SET FORTH HEREIN HAVE BEEN RELIED UPON BY EITHER PARTY.
